comments.author: Blake.C
comments.body: There's a unisex outfit that gives +2 to this skill called Rouxa. It's made with an Atlantis recipe with the Secretary at your home nations palace, villa, etc. It needs R10 sewing and requires 10 Cotton Fabric, 5 Embroidery Thread, and 3 Fine Velvet. The recipe to make this will likely be gone when Atlantis disappears come Age of Rev update, so id take advantage of this ASAP.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: The recipe for this outfit will definitely be gone, as it's related to Ancient Technology Research, which cannot be completed when Atlantis departs. Thanks for reporting it; wish I'd thought to do so a bit sooner.
